name: io.github.billg118/mcp-server-azure-devops
title: Azure DevOps
description: Azure DevOps MCP server: projects, repos, work items, pull requests, pipelines, and wikis.

environmentVariables.name: AZURE_DEVOPS_ORG_URL
environmentVariables.description: Azure DevOps organization URL, e.g. https://dev.azure.com/your-organization

environmentVariables.name: AZURE_DEVOPS_PAT
environmentVariables.description: Personal Access Token (required when AZURE_DEVOPS_AUTH_METHOD is 'pat')

environmentVariables.name: AZURE_DEVOPS_DEFAULT_PROJECT
environmentVariables.description: Default project to use when none is specified
